name: sphere with cylinder
message: Intersect of A (a sphere) and B (a cylinder) is not supported: intersecting curved shapes needs a general solid intersection. Intersect is exact for bricks and polygons, coaxial cylinders and tubes, a cylinder clipped by bricks or polygons along its axis, a tube or cone trimmed by a brick across its axis, and a shape lying completely inside a brick. Instead, Subtract the part you do not want (for example a brick on each side to cut away), or draw the common shape as an extruded polygon or a polyhedron.

name: crossing cylinders
message: Intersect of A (a cylinder) and B (a cylinder) is not supported: the cylinders do not share one axis (crossing or offset cylinders). Intersect is exact for bricks and polygons, coaxial cylinders and tubes, a cylinder clipped by bricks or polygons along its axis, a tube or cone trimmed by a brick across its axis, and a shape lying completely inside a brick. Instead, Subtract the part you do not want (for example a brick on each side to cut away), or draw the common shape as an extruded polygon or a polyhedron.

name: sphere partly in a brick
message: Intersect of A (a sphere) and B (a brick) is not supported: intersecting curved shapes needs a general solid intersection. Intersect is exact for bricks and polygons, coaxial cylinders and tubes, a cylinder clipped by bricks or polygons along its axis, a tube or cone trimmed by a brick across its axis, and a shape lying completely inside a brick. Instead, Subtract the part you do not want (for example a brick on each side to cut away), or draw the common shape as an extruded polygon or a polyhedron.

name: polyhedron with a cone
message: Intersect of A (a polyhedron) and B (a cone) is not supported: intersecting curved shapes needs a general solid intersection. Intersect is exact for bricks and polygons, coaxial cylinders and tubes, a cylinder clipped by bricks or polygons along its axis, a tube or cone trimmed by a brick across its axis, and a shape lying completely inside a brick. Instead, Subtract the part you do not want (for example a brick on each side to cut away), or draw the common shape as an extruded polygon or a polyhedron.

name: add of a part with a cut-out
message: A has a cut-out from an earlier Subtract: Add needs a part without one. Subtract from the result instead, or restore the operands from the Boolean history.

name: subtracting a part with a cut-out
message: B has a cut-out of its own (from an earlier Subtract) and cannot be the part that is subtracted. Restore its operands from the Boolean history first.

name: add of a sheet and a volume
message: Add cannot combine a sheet with a volume: a sheet has zero thickness. Make both operands sheets or both solids.

name: intersect of a volume and a sheet
message: Intersect cannot combine a sheet with a volume: a sheet has zero thickness. Make both operands sheets or both solids.

name: a flat sheet subtracted from a brick
message: B has a sheet (zero thickness) among its shapes: a flat cut-out removes nothing from A. Give it a thickness, or subtract sheets from sheets using bricks and polygons only.

name: a flat shape from a solid
message: B has a sheet (zero thickness) among its shapes: a flat cut-out removes nothing from A. Give it a thickness, or subtract sheets from sheets using bricks and polygons only.

name: a solid and a sheet mixed
message: A mixes sheets and volumes or has a degenerate primitive.
